app.title: My Room
app.description: A collector community where you display what you own in a virtual room, look inside other people's rooms, and turn any piece into a listing as it is.

item.ownedFor: {years, plural, =0 {} =1 {# year } other {# years }}{months, plural, =0 {} =1 {# month} other {# months}}
item.ownerOnlyHint: Where, when and how much you paid are never shown to others.

diary.bodyPlaceholder: What happened with this item today?
diary.plainTextHint: Plain text only. Links are not auto-linked.
diary.errEmpty: Add some text or at least one photo

sanction.blockedTitle: What you can't do right now
sanction.blocked1: Browse the feed, search, market or other rooms
sanction.blocked2: Create or edit items and entries
sanction.appealBody: Write to the address below and we'll take a look.

externalLink.title: You're leaving this service
externalLink.body: This page isn't managed by us. Any transaction is at your own risk.

room.privateDesc: The owner has not made this room public.

market.sortPriceHint: Pick a currency to sort by price
market.dealDisclaimer: Deals happen off-site and are at your own risk.

report.title: Report
report.noAutoHide: Reporting does not hide the content right away. A moderator reviews it first.
report.resultNotice: We'll let you know the outcome in your notifications.

sell.reuseNotice: Photos, attributes and entries are reused. Just set price, currency and link.
sell.dealUrlHint: Paste the URL of your listing. It must start with http or https.
sell.noConversion: Currency is shown as-is, never converted.
sell.privateNotice: This item is private. Listing it will make it public.
sell.privateConfirm: I agree to make this item public
sell.errUrlScheme: Must start with http or https
sell.errNeedsPublic: Agree to make it public to list it
sell.notWired: Validation verified. Saving will work once the backend is wired.
sell.markSoldConfirm: Marking it sold moves it to “items you've let go” and removes it from codex owner counts. You can undo this.

settings.title: Profile settings
settings.roomNameHint: It's fine if someone else uses the same name.
settings.goPrivateWarn: Going private removes {count} listings from the market.
settings.goPublicWarn: Going public puts {count} listings back on the market. Price and link stay as they were.
settings.languageHint: Only the interface changes. Your entries, room name, about and item details stay as written.
settings.blocksHint: Blocking hides both rooms, items, entries and listings from each other. They are not told.

level.dayBoundary: The day resets in your own time zone.

contact.body: If something goes wrong or you want to appeal a restriction, write to the address below.
contact.notReady: We're setting up a contact address

brand.requestDesc: Can't find the brand? Tell us and a moderator will add it.
brand.continueWithoutCodex: You can keep adding items without a codex link until it's approved.
brand.reviewNotice: It won't appear right away. A moderator reviews it first.
brand.alreadyRequested: {count} people already asked for this. Requests are merged.

notif.allOn: You receive all notifications. They can't be turned off.
